derivation: from the base of G4982 (σώφρων) and that of G5424 (σώφρων);
strongs_def: safe (sound) in mind, i.e. self-controlled (moderate as to opinion or passion)
it_def:
1) di mente sana, sano, che possiede i propri sensi
2) che tiene a freno i propri desideri ed impulsi, autocontrollato, moderato
